news.title: Binance hacker splits $1.4 billion of bitcoin into 19 wallets that no one can freeze
news.summary: All 18,270 coins sit in 19 wallets, 17 of them holding exactly 1,000 BTC each, and none has moved since Thursday night, a CoinDesk trace of the blockchain shows.

news.title: $6 billion Binance hack sends bitcoin, ether tumbling; Standard Chartered expects more pain
news.summary: Bitcoin and ether slid after a suspected $6.3 billion Binance security breach and a Polymarket exploit. Standard Chartered says crypto prices may remain under pressure before finding a base.

news.title: Institutional crypto investors rush to pull funds from exchanges after Binance hack
news.summary: The withdrawals suggest the fallout from the multibillion-dollar breach is spreading beyond Binance.
